About Us

About us

TRC Home Improvements is Vincent Taylor. Vince is a third-generation contractor who was, in his own words, steeped in construction at an early age — he spent his childhood weekends on his family's job sites, with uncles and cousins handing him tools and teaching him the trades they had already spent their lives perfecting. Thirty years later, that is still how he works: on the site, tools in hand, every day a job is running. He started TRC in 2017 and has kept it deliberately small — himself and a two-man crew. That is not a limitation, it is the product. The person who walks your bathroom and prices the job is the person who builds it, so nothing gets lost between a salesman's promise and a subcontractor's shortcut. Vince is a fully licensed general contractor for commercial and residential work in both Carolinas (NC GC #106823 and SC #60594), and he sits for continuing education and testing every year to keep those licenses in good standing. The work itself is mostly bathrooms: custom tiled showers, tub-to-shower conversions, walk-in showers built for accessibility, freestanding tubs, and full renovations — plus luxury vinyl plank, laminate and hardwood flooring. Vince has personally torn out and rebuilt dozens of showers that other contractors got wrong, which is why he is blunt about price: the cheapest bid has no value if it has to be done twice, and the most expensive one is often just a big company subbing the job out to someone you will never meet. TRC sits in the middle on price and refuses to sit in the middle on workmanship. TRC is BBB Accredited with an A+ rating, holds a 5.0 average across 24 verified reviews, and serves Fort Mill, Rock Hill, Tega Cay, Indian Land and Lancaster in South Carolina, along with Ballantyne, Waxhaw, Weddington, Indian Trail, Mint Hill, Matthews and Pineville across the North Carolina line. Free design consultations, written estimates, and no deposit to have the conversation.
